title: Fairness in Socio-technical Systems: a Case Study of Wikipedia
reasoning: The paper focuses on the systematic review and causal analysis of bias and 'fairness' within the socio-technical system of Wikipedia. While 'fairness' and 'harm' are ethical concepts, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral frameworks; instead, it uses a taxonomy of harm to categorize social and technical phenomena identified in existing literature.
